title: Find a matching design approval
responsibility: Read approval records and select the latest approval that exactly binds a design version.

inputs.name: hubApproval.context
inputs.description: Source context whose entries include the approval files, which hubRead reads through this context. Every entry under plan.path/designs/approvals/ that ends in .json must be a blob with mode 100644 or 100755, or the call can reject with not-found.

inputs.name: hubApproval.plan
inputs.description: Plan whose unitId a record must carry to match, and whose path selects the approval files: every .json entry under plan.path/designs/approvals/, including nested folders, is read and validated against the approval schema. The other plan fields are not read by this function.

examples.title: Evidence grid
examples.goal: Show a report's evidence files as a grid of thumbnails that open in place.

contract.responsibility: Lay out one report's evidence thumbnails and open the chosen item.

inputs.name: hubApproval.value
inputs.description: The design to match: its version, contractHash and notes sha256 (null when it has no notes) must equal the approval's, and its images, or the images of the option the approval names when the design has options, must match the approval's images by file and sha256. A design with options matches only an approval that names one of its option ids, and a design without options matches only an approval that names no option.

contract.responsibility: Lay out one report's evidence thumbnails and open the chosen item.
Lay out one report's evidence thumbnails and open the chosen item.

options.direction: Compact cards with the file name under each thumbnail.
Large previews with the report date and status beneath each thumbnail.
options.revisedPrompt: Large previews, each with the report date and status beneath it.

outputs.name: hubApproval
outputs.type: Promise<{ id: string; unitId: string; version: string; images: { file: string; sha256: string; }[]; notesSha256: string | null; contractHash: string; approvedAt: string; option?: string | undefined; } | undefined>
outputs.description: The matching approval record with the greatest approvedAt under localeCompare, or undefined when none matches; on equal approvedAt the record listed last in context.entries wins. A record matches when its unitId equals plan.unitId, its version, contractHash and notesSha256 equal those of value (notesSha256 is null when value has no notes), and its images match, by file and sha256, the images of the option it names or, when value has no options, the images of value.

errors.name: not-found
errors.description: Error with code 'not-found', thrown by hubRead through hubFail('not-found') when an approval path in context.entries is not a blob with mode 100644 or 100755. It rejects hubApproval.

errors.name: artifact-corrupt
errors.description: Error with code 'artifact-corrupt', thrown by hubJson when an approval file is not UTF-8 JSON, by hubSchemas when a parsed approval fails hubApprovalSchema, and by hubRead's hubFail() when the fetched bytes of an LFS approval differ in length from its recorded size. Any one of them rejects hubApproval, even for a record that would not match.

errors.name: source read rejection
errors.description: A rejection from hubRaw, hubMaterializedHash, hubBlobProfile, readCache, writeCache or context.source.read is not caught by hubRead, so it passes through unchanged and rejects hubApproval. Those errors are declared outside this unit.
